lines.en: I wonder where we should go this weekend.
How about the art museum by the river?
Good idea. I prefer quiet places these days.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 요즘은 조용한 곳이 더 좋아요.

lines.en: You mentioned that museum last month.
Oh, that's right. Thank you for telling me.
Did you realize it is free on weekdays?
No! Luckily, I have time on a weekday.
Do you expect many people there?
Not in the morning. Hopefully it will be quiet.
lines.ko: 아침에는 안 그래요. 바라건대 조용할 거예요.

lines.en: Then I will drive. Let's leave at ten.
lines.ko: 그럼 제가 운전할게요. 열 시에 나가요.

lines.en: Good afternoon. May I help you?
Yes, please. I wonder about this flower painting.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 이 꽃 그림이 궁금해요.

lines.en: Of course. Please look at it from here.
Oh, now I see the light. Thank you.
Do you recognize the place in it?
Yes! I visited a garden like that long ago.
lines.ko: 네! 오래전에 그런 정원에 가 봤어요.

lines.en: Luckily, we have the painter's letters here too.
lines.ko: 다행히 여기에 그 화가의 편지도 있어요.

lines.en: How wonderful. Which room do you prefer?
lines.ko: 정말 좋네요. 어느 방을 더 좋아하세요?

lines.en: This one. It is quieter in the morning.
I appreciate your help. I will come again.
